content: अर्ज् €1 <ab>P.</ab> [अर्जति, आनर्ज, अर्जिष्यति, आर्जीत्, अर्जितुम्, अर्जित] .²1 To procure, secure, gain, earn, usually in the {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} in this sense; पितृद्रव्याविरोधेन यदन्यत्स्वयमर्जितम् <ls>Y. 2. 118</ls>. .²2 To take up; आनर्जुर्नृभुजोऽस्त्राणि <ls>Bk. 14. 74</ls>. --€10 <ab>P.</ab> or {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} .²1 To procure, acquire, obtain; स्वयमर्जित, स्वार्जित obtained by oneʼs own exertions, self-acquired. .²2 To work or manufacture, make, prepare (सतो गुणान्तराधानम्). --With {@अति@} .²1 to allow, permit, let go. .²2 to remove, despatch, make away with. .{@-अनु@} to let go, set free, deliver. .{@-अपि@} to add to. .{@-अन्वव@} .²1 to cause to go after or in a particular direction. .²2 To visit with anything, overcome. .{@-अप्यति@} to add, append; say something in addition to what is already said. .{@-अव@} to permit to leave, release, let go. .{@-उद्@} to drive out, remove. .{@-प्र@} {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} to furnish, supply, procure.
